What's New

0.19.7 makes sending a message feel immediate. Submitting used to leave the text sitting in the composer for ~1.15 s with an empty transcript, because the cold runtime engage ran inline inside the message request. The message is now painted in the same frame it leaves the box, the composer clears only when the message is actually on screen, and a runtime engage is requested off the request path so the send no longer waits on process start and handshake.

  • One-frame submit: the composer's text leaves the box in the same step the optimistic echo is painted, on both the staged-conversation and the New-chat path; the durable row then replaces the echo in place, so the message is never shown twice (measured: echo applied +0.3 ms after Enter on a warm session, one user row).
  • Cold engage off the critical path: the renderer asks the backend to warm the session as the composer is engaged, gated on session_catalogue >= 3 and degrading to an exact no-op against an older backend.
  • Failure paths keep the user's text: a refused send (413/422) no longer overwrites text typed while the request was in flight, and an ambiguous failure leaves one message rather than a transcript copy plus an editable one.

Impact

  • No breaking changes: the change is renderer-side and gated on a capability the backend advertises, so it is safe in either merge order.
  • Latency: the felt submit lag is gone; the cold engage measured ~1.15 s inside the message request, and the warm route takes it off that path.
  • Disclosure — a waived review dimension: this window's #118 merged with its design round waived by the operator, not cleared. The rendered before/after frames for the submit flow do not exist, because the browser extension's worker stops answering mid-drive on this machine (measured at 13:34, 14:01, 15:0x and 17:0x on 2026-09-13), and no substitute browser engine was used. The code review (two clean rounds), QA (two clean rounds) and UX (terminal) rounds all hold on the merged head; capturing the seven frames and running the design round on them is an open, mechanical follow-up.

PRs

  • #118 feat(chat): make submitting a message register in one frame — merge 240fedae0 — Release: patch

Full Changelog: v0.19.6...v0.19.7
